briefs.title: Growth and investment in Bangladesh: how far does capital formation carry output?
briefs.summary: Peer benchmarks and 5 model specifications on 12 variables (1991–2025) for investment, savings, FDI and growth. The report compares Bangladesh with peer countries on 5 indicators.

briefs.title: Private credit and the banking system in Bangladesh: depth, cost and growth
briefs.summary: Peer benchmarks and 5 model specifications on 12 variables (1992–2025) for private credit, broad money, interest rates and growth. The report compares Bangladesh with peer countries on 4 indicators.

briefs.title: Inflation, the Taka and the stance of policy in Bangladesh, 1992–2025
briefs.summary: Inflation rose to 10.5% in 2024 while lending rates stayed below it in each of the four years from 2022 to 2025. Nine econometric estimates, using 13 official macro variables, find a positive but imprecisely estimated pass-through from Taka depreciation to inflation.
